engineIsolationProof.method: After default initSheetwrite(), require getEngine().CellStore === the CellStore imported from STRING_POOL_CHECKOUT/packages/wasm/loader-node.mjs; reject mismatches before any sample
engineIsolationProof.interpretation: Both execution-level default-loader probes selected their own checkout and different engine interfaces. These subsequent diagnostic executions are not additional matched performance rounds.

methodology.execution: Exclusive quiet.lock, user systemd scope MemoryMax=6G/MemorySwapMax=1G, CPU 4, sequential fresh Bun processes
methodology.roundReduction: Median of the two process medians for each implementation; overall median of five round medians
methodology.noiseReduction: Maximum absolute relative difference between outer and inner pair medians in the three A/A rounds
methodology.units: Milliseconds per complete workload, not per operation
methodology.evidence: Per-round medians recovered from completed tool output; individual timing samples from the first capture were not retained after runtime reset. Fresh sweep samples are retained below.

workloads.edit: 100k committed scalar text edits over the existing 100 categories, without history
workloads.distinct: 20 full distinct-values scans over 1M categorical rows
workloads.publicRead: 30k 64-row public getVisibleWindow calls over 100k categorical rows; checked first-cell text
workloads.distinctIngest: 1M distinct text rows in 10k-row batches; checked final-cell text
workloads.lifetime: 1M distinct live strings, explicit all-live sweeps, clear and explicit compaction, then 100k unique 128-byte-suffix committed overwrites of one cell without history

sweep.interpretation: All-live rebuild is the maximal surviving-text-copy workload at this 1M-cell scale. Observed maximum is not a universal latency guarantee. Sweeps scan physical roots and rebuild the live index; memory and pause still scale with retained roots and historical metadata.

retainedStringOwnersAfterLifetimeWorkloa.interpretation: Rust-owned text/index allocation, excluding unchanged dense cell buffers, history and committed WASM page high-water marks. Baseline retains dead text from the initial cleared 1M-row import as well as subsequent unique edits; candidate reclaims both.

verdict: pass: all six steady-state changes are below 3%; the 1M distinct all-live sweep and retained ownership reduction are reported separately
